inheritance: All canonical Japan38 discrete histories, the source-balanced Japan7 colour stop rule, global-to-local colour claim boundaries, FDT1 calibration evidence, and the unresolved absolute-time gate remain in force unless explicitly updated below.

module_function_bridge.version_note: v1 was removed before merge because focal stickiness intervention direction was inconsistent with the observed nonsticky states of JPN06 and JPN36.

orientation.current_decision: Do not map an orientation adaptation to a named Japan38 branch until transition placement improves. Use functional effects only to define mediator and final-fitness endpoints for future focal manipulation.

phyllary_posture.current_decision: JPN36 is the strongest current ancestry-aware phyllary target. First establish a reversible damage-free phyllary-access manipulation or validated mechanical-access proxy; external Pedicularis bracts are nonhomologous analogs.

intervention_direction.primary_necessity_test: Neutralize natural stickiness in sticky JPN15 versus sham, then measure enemy access/damage, pollinator effective transfer and mature/viable seed output.
intervention_direction.secondary_sufficiency_test: Only after material-equivalence and non-target-effect validation, add a biologically defensible adhesive/restoration treatment to nonsticky JPN06 versus vehicle/sham.
intervention_direction.prohibited_design: Do not describe JPN06 or JPN36 as candidates for stickiness neutralization because their observed authority states are nonsticky/nearly nonsticky.

stickiness.current_decision: The JPN06 nonsticky - JPN15 sticky 100/100 sister pair is the highest-information current stickiness design. Species contrast is not causal by itself; JPN15 within-species neutralization supplies the primary causal test.

colour.current_decision: No further sampling or reprocessing solely to rescue the anti-phylogenetic lightness hypothesis. Colour remains available for independent functional, discrete-state, molecular or field questions.

execution_order.first: Confirm live field expression and manipulation feasibility for JPN06/JPN15 stickiness and JPN36 appressed phyllaries. Do not proceed from authority categories directly to destructive manipulation.
execution_order.second: Use JPN15 sticky neutralization versus sham as the primary stickiness necessity test; measure enemy access/damage, pollinator effective transfer and mature/viable seed jointly. JPN06 restoration/addition is a secondary sufficiency experiment only after material equivalence is validated.
execution_order.third: Pilot a reversible damage-free JPN36 phyllary-access manipulation or validated mechanical-access proxy versus sham, measuring enemy attack, pollinator access and mature/viable seed jointly.
execution_order.fourth: Repair missing primary states in parallel: JPN34 orientation, JPN15 phyllary posture, JPN24 stickiness; recompute histories before naming additional branch-specific targets.
execution_order.fifth: For orientation, improve transition localization before ancestry-specific testing; meanwhile retain the pollination/protection/net-fitness calibration as endpoint priors only.
execution_order.sixth: Only after focal functional contrasts are established should FDT4/FDT7 connect transition histories to niche regimes or simulations. Absolute-time FDT5/FDT6 remains conditional on the dating gate.

do_not_repeat: Do not resume colour sampling merely to obtain a negative anti-phylogenetic rho.
Do not pool orientation, phyllary and stickiness into one common effect size.
Do not treat Pedicularis bracts as homologous Cirsium phyllaries or Bejaria/Datura as transported Cirsium stickiness effects.
Do not neutralize stickiness in JPN06 or JPN36 when the frozen observed states are nonsticky/nearly nonsticky.
Do not infer causality from the JPN06-JPN15 sister-state contrast without within-species manipulation.
Do not label JPN36 orientation as a transition target because no orientation ML edge is individually forced.
Do not call the absence of common-lability overlap proof of developmental or genetic modular evolvability.
claim_boundary: State-aware readiness and experiment-prioritization contract only. Repeated-state histories plus external functional calibrations generate discriminating hypotheses, not adaptation claims. Sister-state contrast, functional homology, branch-specific selection, niche coupling, timing and molecular mechanism each require separate evidence gates.
